(i) the classical energy/charges relation for spinning strings on regular AdS5xS5 backgrounds is not modified at the one-loop level in the limit of large angular momentum; (ii) the classical energy is an exact series expansion in positive powers in the effective string coupling; (iii) the quantum correction to the energy is non perturbative in the effective string tension; (iv) the quantum correction is exponentially suppressed in the limit of high angular momentum.

the one loop quantum corrections to the circular spinning string are non-perturba- tive in nature and are of the same order as the leading classical term in the expansion in the BMN effective cou- pling.
